cases.name: no-shell-without-a-document
cases.covers: Document-scoped: before start, before any document opens, and for an unknown document, the capability does not resolve.

cases.name: surfaces
cases.covers: open/close/toggle and every selector: exclusive tags close their siblings, props ride along and are replaced on reopen, closing keeps the surface (closed), toggle opens with its options and closes without them.

cases.name: menus
cases.covers: openMenu appends once, closeMenu removes, toggleMenu picks by membership, closeAllMenus empties (and is a no-op when empty); openMenus keeps opening order.

cases.name: per-document-state
cases.covers: Each document has its own shell; the unaddressed capability follows the active document; closing a document drops its slice, and reopening it starts fresh.

cases.name: props-close-all-and-snapshots
cases.covers: updateSurfaceProps replaces props without reopening (and ignores an unknown id); closeAll closes every surface and keeps them; getSnapshot omits focus requests; applySnapshot replaces surfaces and menus wholesale, dropping ones it does not name.

cases.name: focus-requests
cases.covers: Repeated focused opens raise a moment counter without another opened event; every close and snapshot restore clears it; unrelated surfaces keep their records.

cases.name: events
cases.covers: Every write is diffed: onSurfaceOpened and onSurfaceClosed fire per surface whose open flag changed, with props when opened and id only when closed (including exclusive siblings and surfaces a snapshot drops); onMenuOpened and onMenuClosed fire per menu, closes first. A write that changes nothing fires nothing, and after unsubscribing nothing fires.
